ValidationRule.description: Checks if Account is a Sold-To/Other Customer Account before letting user add Parent Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), OR( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Sold-to')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Others')) ), RecordType.DeveloperName != 'PMC_SS_Customer' ), NOT(ISBLANK( ParentId )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Account you’re on is not a Sold-to/Other Account. Only Sold-to/Other accounts can use the Parent Account field.
